sections.title: Core Foundations & Conceptual Framework
sections.content:
• **Trigger**: The Bombay Presidency government increased land revenue by **30%** in 1927 despite falling agricultural prices.
• **Leadership**: **Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel** was invited by local leaders (Kunji Lal Mehta, Kalyanji Mehta) to lead the movement.
• **Methodology**: Use of **Satyagraha**, social boycott of government officials, and establishment of 'Swaraj Ashrams' to organize the peasantry.
• **Key Metric / Factor**: The movement was strictly **non-violent** and focused on the refusal to pay taxes until the government agreed to an independent inquiry.

sections.title: Comprehensive Classification & Comparative Matrix
rows: Economic distress due to revenue hike

items.definition: A daily newsletter published to keep the peasants informed and maintain morale during the struggle.
The committee appointed by the government to investigate the revenue hike; it concluded the 30% increase was unjustified and reduced it to 6.03%.

items.title: Major Applications / Initiatives
items.content:
• **Social Mobilization**: Massive participation of women (e.g., Mithuben Petit, Bhaktiba Desai) who gave Patel the title 'Sardar'.
• **Institutional Framework**: Creation of a parallel administrative structure through village committees.

items.title: Challenges & Way Forward
items.content:
• **Key Challenges**: Government confiscation of land and cattle; threat of police repression.
• **Solutions**: Sustained non-violent discipline and national media coverage to pressure the colonial state.

items.title: Mnemonic for Retention
items.content:
• **Memory Acronym**: 'B-S-P' (Bardoli, Sardar, Patrika).
• **Decoded Meaning**: Bardoli movement led by Sardar Patel, utilized the Patrika for communication.

upscNotes.content: Examiner Trap: UPSC often confuses the Bardoli Satyagraha with the Champaran Satyagraha. Remember: Bardoli was about land revenue (tax), while Champaran was about the Tinkathia system (indigo cultivation).
Mains Value Addition: Use the term 'Satyagraha as a tool of political bargaining' to describe the Bardoli movement in the context of Indian nationalism.

keyTakeaways: The movement resulted in the total victory of the peasants with the reduction of revenue to 6.03%.
It established Sardar Patel as a national-level leader of the Indian National Congress.
It demonstrated the effectiveness of non-violent mass civil disobedience in the agrarian sector.
